sense.evidence: Mostly fits: "the first mob of Kurdish families", "giving them their dues", "gives a big rap to", "a proper hub", "working shoulder to shoulder". "pulling their weight" undersells "an important role".

authenticity.evidence: Natural Aussie: "has gone and officially marked", "VOA got hold of", "the first lot of Kurdish families". Reads like an Australian telling the news.

register.evidence: Clearly retold in Aussie voice, but more a chatty news read than a level-5 pub yarn; no swearing, which is allowed. Somewhat lighter than asked.

tone.evidence: Keeps the warm, honouring tone of the proclamation story; the casual voice doesn't mock it.

flow.evidence: Reads smoothly: "Nashville's now home to more than 20,000 Kurds, which makes it one of the biggest Kurdish communities in the United States."

variety.evidence: Varied: "mob", "first lot", "giving them their dues", "big rap", "pulling their weight", "proper hub", "gives a nod", "shoulder to shoulder", "teaming up".

essence.evidence: Unmistakably the VOA story about the proclamation, in its order.
